How much detail should the paintings carry?

The same three subjects at four levels of fidelity, from today's detailed painting down to a few brushstrokes. Pick one level, and the other 27 will be painted at it.

  • F0 · CurrentDetailed. Layered ink, rendered texture, full background. What is on dev now.
  • F1 · Loose brushForms built from visible strokes, no rendered texture, a lighter background.
  • F2 · Xieyi freehandEach form in a few bold strokes, ink bleeding into the paper, mostly empty paper.
  • F3 · Zen minimalA handful of strokes in the manner of Muqi and Bada Shanren. Almost all paper.
